Looking at the error, the issue occurs when trying to access `previous_episode['Title'].iloc[0]` when `previous_episode` is empty. This happens because the code assumes there will always be a previous episode with `Series #` one less in the same season. However, if "Robin Hood Play" is the first episode in the season, there won't be a previous episode.

The fix is to handle the case where `previous_episode` might be empty by checking its length first.

~~~python
# Filter the dataframe to find the row with title "Robin Hood Play"
robin_hood_row = df[df['Title'] == 'Robin Hood Play']

# Get the season number and series number for that episode
season_num = robin_hood_row['Season #'].iloc[0]
series_num = robin_hood_row['Series #'].iloc[0]

# Find the previous episode in the same season with the series number one less
previous_episode = df[(df['Season #'] == season_num) & (df['Series #'] == series_num - 1)]

# Extract the title of the previous episode if it exists
if len(previous_episode) > 0:
    answer = previous_episode['Title'].iloc[0]
else:
    answer = None
~~~
